title: Forbidden
description: The mistress (Barbara Stanwyck) of a lawyer (Adolphe Menjou) running for governor marries an editor (Ralph Bellamy), who finds she has a baby.

title: Mickey One
description: A nightclub comic (Warren Beatty) in debt to mobsters hides in Chicago at the mercy of his ego.

title: Cactus Flower
description: A dentist (Walter Matthau) has his prim assistant (Ingrid Bergman) pose as his wife to discourage his kooky girlfriend (Goldie Hawn).

title: Holiday
description: A tomboy New York socialite (Katharine Hepburn) flirts with her stuffy sister's (Doris Nolan) down-to-earth fiancé (Cary Grant).

title: You Can't Run Away From It
description: A newsman (Jack Lemmon) rides a bus, hitchhikes and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Charles Bickford) runaway daughter (June Allyson).

title: Anatomy of a Murder
description: A Michigan lawyer (James Stewart) and his colleague defend an Army lieutenant (Ben Gazzara) who killed the man who raped the officer's wife (Lee Remick).

title: Oliver!
description: Dickens' Oliver Twist goes from parish boy to Fagin's pickpocketing school to the clutches of murderous Bill Sikes.

title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
description: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.

title: Queen Bee
description: A boozing Atlanta millionaire's (Barry Sullivan) wicked wife (Joan Crawford) acts charming to people at their mansion.

title: Rusty Leads the Way
description: A boy (Ted Donaldson) and his dog try to help their new friend, a girl (Sharyn Moffett) struggling with her blindness.

title: The Howards of Virginia
description: Politics divide a Williamsburg couple (Cary Grant, Martha Scott) as events lead to the Revolutionary War.

title: Miss Sadie Thompson
description: A shady woman (Rita Hayworth) from San Francisco joins Marines and a moral reformer (Jose Ferrer) in the postwar Pacific.

title: Dead Reckoning
description: A World War II hero (Humphrey Bogart) solves his buddy's murder, starting with a singer (Lizabeth Scott) and a nightclub owner (Morris Carnovsky).

title: It Happened to Jane
description: A Maine lobsterwoman (Doris Day) has her lawyer (Jack Lemmon) sue a railroad tycoon (Ernie Kovacs) over a spoiled shipment.

title: The Fuller Brush Girl
description: A door-to-door saleswoman (Lucille Ball) and her boyfriend (Eddie Albert) flee from mobsters and the police after a murder mix-up.

title: Under the Yum Yum Tree
description: A lusty landlord (Jack Lemmon) eyes a coed (Carol Lynley) who is trying to live platonically with her boyfriend (Dean Jones).

title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
description: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.

title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
description: A country bumpkin faces ridicule and corruption when he takes his idealistic views to the nation's capital.

title: Oliver!
description: Dickens' Oliver Twist goes from parish boy to Fagin's pickpocketing school to the clutches of murderous Bill Sikes.

title: Hellcats of the Navy
description: A submarine commander (Ronald Reagan) enters the Sea of Japan with a frogman who had flirted with his girlfriend (Nancy Davis).

title: Eight Iron Men
description: GIs sit in a bombed-out house with a comrade trapped outside; then one (Bonar Colleano) does something.

title: Bonjour tristesse
description: At the height of summer, 18-year-old Cécile is relaxing by the French seaside with her father and falling in love with her new boyfriend. However, the arrival of her late mother's enigmatic friend soon turns her world upside down.

title: The Happy Time
description: A violinist (Charles Boyer) and his brother (Louis Jourdan) guide one's son through his crush on the family maid in the 1920s Ottawa.

title: The Mouse That Roared
description: The field marshal, prime minister and grand duchess (Peter Sellers) of Fenwick declare war on the United States.

title: Only Angels Have Wings
description: A sassy chorus girl (Jean Arthur) falls in love with a seat-of-the-pants pilot (Cary Grant) in South America.

title: Divorce American Style
description: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.

title: It Happened One Night
description: A newsman (Clark Gable) rides a bus and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Walter Connolly) runaway daughter (Claudette Colbert).

title: The Caine Mutiny
description: A World War II Naval officer is court-martialed for relieving paranoid Capt. Queeg of command during a typhoon.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.

title: Anatomy of a Murder
description: A Michigan lawyer (James Stewart) and his colleague defend an Army lieutenant (Ben Gazzara) who killed the man who raped the officer's wife (Lee Remick).

title: Operation Mad Ball
description: An Army private (Jack Lemmon) and his buddies try to fraternize with nurses who are off-limits as officers.

title: Boston Blackie and the Law
description: Reformed thief Blackie (Chester Morris) does a magic show in a women's prison, during which an inmate escapes.

title: The Taming of the Shrew
description: Shakespeare's Petruchio weds Katharina on his own terms in Padua.

title: Autumn Leaves
description: A New England spinster (Joan Crawford) marries a younger man (Cliff Robertson) who has mental problems and another wife (Vera Miles).

title: The Magic Carpet
description: An ousted prince harnesses the power of a mystical floor covering to drive a villainous caliph from the throne.

title: Theodora Goes Wild
description: A small-town New England author (Irene Dunne) meets her racy novel's urbane illustrator (Melvyn Douglas) in Manhattan.

title: You Can't Take It With You
description: An eccentric patriarch meets the stuffy parents of his granddaughter's fiancé.

title: Holiday
description: A tomboy New York socialite (Katharine Hepburn) flirts with her stuffy sister's (Doris Nolan) down-to-earth fiancé (Cary Grant).

title: His Girl Friday
description: An ace reporter's editor, her ex-husband, tries everything possible to stop her from remarrying someone else.
